description: Tronçons du RVA pour la gestion des sens de circulation des bus par la STAR is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche contient les tronçons du Référentiel Voies et Adresses de Rennes Métropole (RVA) renseignés par les informations viaires gérées par Rennes Métropole et nécessaires à la gestion des itinéraires des bus du Réseau STAR par la société Keolis. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are route. The portal shows 76,384 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
